_benchmark_note: BOUNDED SPRINT 4 EVALUATION BENCHMARK - NOT A TRAINING, TUNING OR GENERAL ACCURACY DATASET. This set exists to measure the already-implemented Multimodal Species Recognition Agent and to support weakness analysis. It is far too small to justify any claim about BioCLIP-2 accuracy or about species recognition in general. It must never be used to train or fine-tune a model, to tune prompts, or to move the confidence thresholds 0.75 / 0.08 / 0.45, which were fixed long before this dataset existed. No expected value here was produced by, copied from, or confirmed against a Recognition Agent output: species identity comes from each image's own public source page plus direct visual inspection, and taxonomy identifiers come from official GBIF and NCBI sources.
permitted_use: measuring the existing agent against documented cases

ground_truth_sources.species_identity: Wikimedia Commons file page and species category, plus direct visual inspection of every selected image
ground_truth_sources.gbif: https://api.gbif.org/v1/species/match - accepted only on matchType=EXACT, rank=SPECIES and status=ACCEPTED
ground_truth_sources.ncbi: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi - accepted only on an exact binomial at rank species
ground_truth_sources.note: Verification was carried out once by the dataset author as research and written down here. No test and no code path in this repository contacts GBIF, NCBI or any other external service.

categories.real_recognition: A photograph of a live animal whose species is independently established.
categories.ambiguous_or_non_animal: No identifiable live animal, or an object or depiction rather than an organism. Never scored for species.
categories.invalid_input_or_dependency_failure: Contract violations and controlled dependency failures. Scored on status and error code only.
categories.delegation_resume: Scientific follow-up requests that must escalate a capability, and the resume half of that contract.

cases.ground_truth_basis: Behavioural expectation derived from adapters/bioclip.py, which maps every remote failure onto the single controlled code CLASSIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE and never falls back to fixture data. Exercised by injecting a failing transport, never by taking a real provider offline.
cases.notes: Dependency-failure case. The classification transport is injected and made to fail; no live provider is contacted and no real outage is caused.

applicability.live_reason: Deliberately excluded from live runs: it would mean breaking a real provider call, and the behaviour is already fully determined by an injected transport.

cases.instruction: What is the genome of the animal in this photograph?
cases.ground_truth_basis: Behavioural expectation derived from workflows/nodes.py::make_delegation_node, which delegates only when the intent is scientific_follow_up, the decision is identified, a primary species exists and a capability was recognised. The species is the independently verified subject of the image.
cases.notes: Delegation case. 'genome' is a Genome trigger word in text_analysis._FOLLOW_UP_CAPABILITIES, so the intent becomes scientific_follow_up and the capability hint is Genome. Delegation is conditional on the classifier reaching identified; if it does not, that is a recorded finding about the classifier, not a dataset defect.

applicability.offline_reason: Requires a real identification before delegation can fire, which the three-digest mock oracle cannot produce for this image.
